interface.longDescription:
Look up how real mobile apps handle a task while you design. Ask for onboarding, sign-up, checkout, search or booking, and Flownato shows the screens of each flow in the order people go through them. You can also find single screens, such as login or paywall screens, and UI elements like bottom sheets or sticky buttons, shown inside the full screen they come from.

Use it to compare how different apps solve the same problem, collect references for a design review, or check a pattern before you build it.

Flownato covers mobile apps only. Screens are recorded from the live apps, so a particular app or flow may not be included yet. Connecting needs a Flownato account.
defaultPrompt: Show me onboarding welcome screens from real apps
Compare how apps handle phone login with an OTP
Find real examples of a payment method screen
